## Summary

Implements ADR 0112 by replacing MMD-specific cosmetic physics runtime contracts with engine-native Secondary Motion.

This follow-up fixes the remaining Editor animation-preview references to the removed MMD physics resource/system and corrects Rapier 0.35 velocity assertions found by trusted Windows Validation. The PR remains Draft while the final compatibility cleanup, PMX best-effort conversion diagnostics, documentation, and visual validation are completed.
